title: T1199 — Trusted Relationship
subtitle: A phished IT vendor becomes a bridge into hundreds of customer endpoints.
aria: Animated simulation of a trusted relationship attack: an attacker phishes a small IT vendor, steals VPN and RMM admin credentials, logs into a customer environment as the trusted vendor, pushes a command to 500 managed agents, deploys ransomware, and the SOC detects the vendor sign-in anomaly and mass agent command.
